page: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure VM.Standard.E6.Ax.Flex.4-64 is a flexible virtual machine instance configured with an emphasis on high memory density and strong per-core computational throughput. Driven by the AMD EPYC 9J45 processor running at a base clock speed of 2.7 GHz, this x86_64 system provides 4 dedicated physical cores supporting multithreading across 8 virtual CPUs. Cache architecture features 64 KB of L1 data cache, 0.5 MB of L2 cache, and 16 MB of L3 cache, backed by vector instruction sets including AVX-512 (f, vnni, and bf16) alongside cryptographic acceleration via AES and SHA-NI.

System memory totals 64.0 GB, yielding a high 1:8 core-to-memory ratio of 8.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. This instance configuration does not bundle local storage, relying on external network block storage for persistence, and includes no discrete GPU hardware. One complimentary public IPv4 address is provided for external ingress and egress traffic.

Benchmark assessments reveal top-tier single-thread computational performance, highlighted by a Geekbench single-core score of 2666.0 and a stress-ng single-core rating of 3462.99. Instruction execution tests also excel in data transformation, achieving 38.34 GB/sec in single-threaded gzip compression and 16.98 GB/sec in single-threaded bzip3 decompression. Memory subsystems demonstrate strong throughput, with PassMark memory scoring in the top quartile and uncached read bandwidth reaching 52.48 GB/sec. Conversely, multi-threaded throughput falls in the middle tiers, reflecting the 8-vCPU constraint, while larger language model prompt evaluation exhibits lower relative speed.

The instance delivers efficient resource utilization for applications that demand substantial memory footprints without incurring the cost of massive core allocations. With 15.3 million Redis SET operations per second and solid database operational marks, it is best suited for in-memory caches, memory-bound relational databases, intermediate data transformation pipelines, and backend application serving.
description: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure VM.Standard.E6.Ax.Flex.4-64 is an x86_64 virtual machine featuring 8 vCPUs across 4 dedicated physical AMD EPYC 9J45 cores clocked at 2.7 GHz. Equipped with 64.0 GB of system memory, the instance establishes a generous 1:8 compute-to-RAM ratio suited for memory-intensive services. Hardware acceleration covers AVX-512 and cryptographic extensions, while local storage is omitted in favor of remote volumes, and no discrete GPUs are bundled. Benchmark results show top-tier single-thread performance in Geekbench (2666.0) and compression suites alongside a strong PassMark memory score. Multi-core capacity and large-model prompt processing reflect standard mid-range results commensurate with the 8-vCPU allocation. The hardware profile is optimal for in-memory data caches, web backends, and moderate relational databases requiring higher memory capacity relative to core count.
